status: Recorded for follow-up; no gameplay fixes applied during this analytics review.

findings.report: Target designator emits no visible laser.
Medic injector is missing; a blaster pistol appears instead.
Raise red dot and adjust zeroing so the barrel does not obstruct it.
Armed shocktroop grenade is not launched when thrown.
Technician drill is replaced by the primary launcher.
Medic and technician cannot deploy boxes.
Offhand pistol grip forces the weapon angle downwards.
Move transport driver and cabin passenger positions slightly forward.
Hide HUD while viewing through a scope.
Keep map and menu in front of the player while locomoting.
Reauthor jungle ambience to remove cityscape sounds and lower overall ambience volume.
Restore charging information on the Massacre launcher info panel.
Water kills the player before there is an opportunity to swim.
Suicide requires multiple button presses to register.
